answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a hydrostatic bearing thermal signature whose drift is costly to clone, letting honest nodes verify provenance as cedar marker in a shared meadow. To forge a sybil swarm, an attacker must replicate that signature across nodes, which stalls the inducer-style admission queue and exposes correlated cavitation noise. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
